description_en: Invokes the DeleteBasicEndpoint operation to delete an endpoint of a basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用DeleteBasicEndpoint接口删除基础型全球加速实例的终端节点
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-basic-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBasicEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Set this parameter to a value that is generated from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to delete belongs. You can call the [ListBasicEndpointGroups](~~~~) operation to query the endpoint group ID of a basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的基础型全球加速实例终端节点所属的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to delete from the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
EndpointId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID
